start: A workout open, MettleUp swiped away from recents, a rest card showing 'Done' for a set the phone cannot tick on its own

user_sees: A quiet note: 'Open MettleUp to save <exercise, set>' with 'MettleUp was closed. Open it within 10 min to log this set.'; the live workout card goes down while it shows
must_not: The set shown as saved when it was not
A sound or watch buzz for the note

user_sees: MettleUp opens, the set is ticked, the note goes, the live workout card comes back
must_not: The note staying after the app took the tap

start: MettleUp in the background, a rest card's Done for a set whose numbers are not filled in

user_sees: A note 'Open MettleUp to log <set>' with '<what is missing> — nothing was saved.'
must_not: A set saved with empty numbers

steps.action: Tap 'Done' on an older rest card that no longer matches the workout
user_sees: A note 'Open MettleUp to log your set' with 'That rest card was out of date, so nothing was saved.'
must_not: A different set ticked than the card named

start: The note 'Open MettleUp to save ...' showing

steps.action: Wait more than 10 minutes, then open MettleUp
user_sees: The note has gone by itself; the set is not ticked silently at the late time
must_not: A set logged with a time 10+ minutes after the tap without the member seeing it

start: The note showing, live workout card down

user_sees: The live workout card comes back; the tap still waits for the app
must_not: No MettleUp notification left at all
The tap lost by the swipe

steps.action: Tap 'Done' on a second card before opening the app
user_sees: Only the newest tap is kept
The note with the set name shows on the lock screen (public visibility)
must_not: Anything but the exercise and set name
The note sent to the watch with a buzz
